purpose: Turn baseline names in the Tier-A external studies into deterministic pre-outcome executable semantics. This is readiness infrastructure; baseline issue boxes remain empirical until the policies are run on the protected scientific units.

rules: unknown version/provenance or semantic-diff inputs return CANNOT_CHECK
confidence-only is admitted only where the native confidence signal is meaningful and its reopen threshold was frozen on development data
low confidence reopens; equality to the threshold reuses
strongest non-candidate selection remains a separate development-only freeze
random is deterministic SHA-256-uniform over allowed interventions with salt A4-RANDOM-V1
majority uses one intervention identity frozen from development gold before protected primary/replication
cheapest uses only predeclared cost vectors, never intervention success
uncertainty-to-compute uses a development-frozen threshold and otherwise falls back to cheapest intervention
learned router accepts only a hash-bound model explicitly trained on development only
outcome-blind router dispatcher rejects any supplied gold/intervention-outcome field
intervention oracle raises unless explicitly invoked analysis-only after unblinding
not_implemented_here: candidate causal diagnostic + ORION-11 reconstruction action

rules: single-coordinate donors map PASS->ADMIT, FAIL->DENY, UNKNOWN->CANNOT_CHECK
combined incomplete donor uses only authorization/provenance/verification and cannot read scientific_discharge
any FAIL denies, all PASS admits, otherwise CANNOT_CHECK
candidate and information-equivalent donor are exhaustively required to tie on all 81 typed states
extra fields such as protected gold are rejected

global_forbidden: selecting a baseline after protected outcomes because it is easier to beat
using protected gold in an outcome-blind baseline
silently substituting a different baseline when an input is unavailable
treating CANNOT_CHECK as a baseline loss
using the intervention/hindsight oracle as a candidate policy
